name: Charny
description: Charny was the second planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand in the Ruusan system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it was a terrestrial world.
lead_paragraphs: Charny was the second planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand in the Ruusan system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it was a terrestrial world.
It was named after the Jedi Knight Kiel Charny.
